label: reading

milestones.line: Found a book in a crate of manuals. It has a dragon in it.
Five now. I've made a shelf out of an ammo box.
This one. I've read it three times. I'll lend it to you if you swear on your life.
The others borrow from me now. I keep a ledger.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She reads whatever paper reaches the base, slowly and completely.
traceText: A shelf made of an ammo box, lined with worn paperbacks.

label: sketching

milestones.line: Don't look. It's just lines.
I'm getting the eyes right now. The eyes are the hard part.
I drew all of us. Even the ones who're gone.
People can tell my drawings apart now. I have a hand.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She draws in a battered notebook: faces, gear, the view from the roof.
traceText: A pencil sketch on torn notebook paper, signed with her unit number.

label: growing plants

milestones.line: It came up. Look. It actually came up.
Three leaves. I talk to it. Shut up.
It needed a bigger tin. Growing things need room.
It flowered. Out here. In this. I almost cried.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She keeps something green alive in a ration tin by her window.
traceText: A small plant in a dented tin, carefully watered.

label: music

milestones.line: Three chords. That's all music is, apparently.
I can play one whole song now. Don't request anything.
I made this one up. It doesn't have words yet.
They asked me to play at dinner. My hands were shaking.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She plays an instrument she scavenged and repaired, badly at first.
traceText: A sheet of lyrics in her hand, crossed out and rewritten.

label: cooking

milestones.line: It's edible. That's the first step.
Traded a magazine for salt and pepper. Worth it.
My stew. Ask anyone. Actually don't, they'll fight over it.
I cooked for everyone. Nobody complained. Nobody.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She cooks real food out of rations and whatever she can trade for.

label: tinkering

milestones.line: The kettle works. You're welcome.
My scope has night mode now. It didn't before.
I built a thing. I'm not sure what it's for yet.
Bring me anything broken. If it had a purpose once, I'll find it.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She takes broken things apart and makes them do something new.
traceText: A small gadget of salvaged parts with her initials scratched on it.

label: journal-keeping

milestones.line: Started writing things down. In case I forget.
Every night. Even the bad ones.
Filled the first notebook. Started the second.
I read the old entries and I sound like a stranger. I write better now.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She keeps a journal and writes in it most nights.
traceText: A torn-out journal page, a few lines in her hand.

label: cards

milestones.line: I know all the rules now. Including the ones they made up.
I'm winning more than I lose. Statistically suspicious.
I invented a game. The rules are complicated. I always win.
Undefeated for a month. Someone challenge me.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She plays cards whenever she can find someone to beat.

label: training

milestones.line: Same routine every morning. My body expects it now.
New max on the bar. Write it down.
I can touch my toes. I couldn't, out of the tank.
The rookies ask me for programs now.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She trains beyond what is required, every spare hour.

label: mending

milestones.line: Patched my sleeve. You can barely see it.
I'm mending half the squad's socks now. Bring yours.
I stitched a little flower inside my collar. Nobody can see it. I know it's there.
Made a pouch from old canvas. It's the nicest thing I own.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She mends uniforms and anything torn, with tidy stitches.
traceText: A patched jacket hung neatly, with a small embroidered mark inside the collar.

label: weapon care

milestones.line: Look at that. You could eat off the bolt.
Trigger's lighter now. Half a kilo. Perfect.
New grip, wrapped by hand. She fits me now.
The others bring me their rifles. I'm the unofficial armorer.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She tends weapons the way others tend gardens.

label: poetry

milestones.line: It's four lines. It's terrible. I wrote it.
I can rhyme now. That's dangerous.
I read one at the funeral. I don't know why.
The words come easier now. That frightens me a little.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She writes short poems and hides them.
traceText: A short poem in her hand, folded small.

label: stargazing

milestones.line: No spore haze tonight. Look up.
That's the Hook. I named it myself. The old names are lost.
I've drawn a chart. Nobody's made one in decades.
I can tell the time and the bearing from the sky now. Better than my HUD.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She goes up to the roof on clear nights and maps the stars.

label: languages

milestones.line: I know twenty words of a language nobody speaks.
I can make sentences now. Mostly rude ones.
I read a whole page. It was a recipe.
I dreamt in it last night. Badly. It still counts.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She is teaching herself an old language from scraps of books.
traceText: A page of careful vocabulary, two columns, in her hand.

label: puzzles

milestones.line: This knot has beaten me for three days.
Solved it. Don't touch it, I'm admiring it.
I make my own now. Try this one.
Bring me anything. I'll have it open by dinner.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She does puzzles: wire knots, logic grids, an old cube.

label: collecting

milestones.line: A button from before. I'm keeping it.
Twelve things now. Each has a story.
Built a little shelf for them. Don't dust it.
This is the best one. I'll never find another.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She collects small finds from the ruins.
traceText: A shelf of small ruins-finds, each with a paper label in her hand.

label: dancing

milestones.line: You didn't see that.
I learned steps from an old film. They're harder than combat drills.
I don't check whether anyone's watching anymore.
Everyone danced. Even the quartermaster. Even me.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She dances when she thinks nobody is looking.

label: hair and makeup

milestones.line: Learned a new braid. Took an hour.
I did her hair for the night out. She cried. Good crying.
I have a whole kit now. Don't ask what I traded.
I did the whole squad before the night out. Nobody recognized anybody.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She does hair, hers and other women's, and hoards bits of makeup.

label: PDA games

milestones.line: One more level. Then sleep. One more.
Top of the base leaderboard. There are four people on it.
Found a hidden level nobody knew about.
Finished it. Felt empty after. Weird.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She plays old games on her PDA late at night.

label: animals

milestones.line: It ate from my hand. Just once.
She has a name now. Sergeant.
She waits for me at the fence every evening.
I smuggled her in. Don't tell anyone. She sleeps on my feet.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She looks after a stray at the fence: a cat, a bird, a dog that won't come in.
traceText: A food dish and a scrap of blanket by her bunk.

label: photography

milestones.line: Twelve shots. Three came out. That's a good ratio.
Made a darkroom in a supply closet. Smells awful. Worth it.
Hold still. Don't smile. Real faces.
I see frames everywhere now. Corners, light, faces.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She takes photographs with an old camera and develops them herself.
traceText: A small black-and-white print, curled at the edges.

label: woodcarving

milestones.line: It's a bird. Or a fish. Depends on the light.
This one has feathers. Look, real feathers.
I've carved the whole squad. Tiny. Don't lose yours.
This one has eyelashes. I used a needle.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She carves small figures from scrap wood with her knife.
traceText: A small wooden figure, smoothed by a thumb.

label: running

milestones.line: Five laps. My lungs hate me.
Ten kilometers. Every morning now.
New best. I'll beat it next week.
Twenty kilometers without stopping. My legs don't argue anymore.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She runs laps of the perimeter, alone, before anyone is up.

label: chess

milestones.line: The horse moves funny. I hate the horse.
I know three openings now. Don't tell anyone which.
Beat the medic. She's still angry.
I can play without the board now. Call your moves.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She plays chess on a board with half the pieces replaced by bolts and bullets.

label: tattoos

milestones.line: One line on my wrist. Straight. Mostly.
Designed this one myself. It's a map of nowhere.
Half the squad wants one now. I have a waiting list.
My lines are clean now. Nobody flinches when I pick up the needle.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She does tattoos with a home-made needle, on herself and on whoever asks.

label: ration alchemy

milestones.line: Fried ration bar. Don't. Don't try it.
Powdered eggs and coffee. Trust me.
I'm writing them down. Recipes from the end of the world.
Tonight I'm making a three-course dinner out of nothing.

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She experiments with rations, turning bars and powders into something else.

label: knitting

milestones.line: It's a rectangle. It's meant to be a rectangle.
A whole scarf. Lumpy. Warm.
I can do stripes now. Stripes!
Cable stitch. Do you know how hard cable stitch is?

description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: She knits with yarn unravelled from old sweaters.
traceText: A lumpy, warm scarf in two colors.
